You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To prepare for a closing, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Request final payoff statement from the mortgage lender (3 days)
Step 2. Finalize the disbursement of funds to the seller (2 hours)
Step 3. Execute the transfer of property deed (45 minutes)
Step 4. Confirm the wire transfer has been initiated (30 minutes)
Step 5. Receive confirmation of wire receipt by the escrow agent (1 hour)
Step 6. Conduct the preliminary title search (2 days)
Step 7. Resolve any outstanding liens discovered in the title search (5 days)
Step 8. Obtain the homeowner's insurance binder (1 day)
Step 9. Complete the final walk-through of the property (2 hours)
Step 10. Sign the promissory note for the new loan (30 minutes)
Step 11. Review the title insurance policy details (2 hours)
Step 12. Hand over the keys to the new owner (15 minutes)
Step 13. Schedule the official closing appointment (20 minutes)
Step 14. Record the new deed at the county office (4 hours)
Step 15. Verify the property's legal description is accurate (1 hour)
Step 16. Distribute copies of the signed documents to all parties (1 hour)
Step 17. Notarize the seller's affidavit (30 minutes)
Step 18. Submit the final loan package to the underwriter (1 day)
Step 19. Cancel the seller's existing utility accounts (1 hour)
Step 20. Order the property appraisal report (1 week)
Step 21. Review the bill of sale for personal property (30 minutes)
Step 22. Prepare the final Closing Disclosure (CD) (4 hours)
Step 23. Draft the initial purchase agreement (2 hours)
Step 24. Confirm property taxes are prorated correctly (2 hours)
Step 25. Update the public land records (1 day)
Step 26. Check for any recent judgments against the parties (3 hours)
Step 27. Archive the digital transaction file (2 hours)
Step 28. Sign the settlement statement (1 hour)
Step 29. Retain a real estate attorney (2 days)
Step 30. Verify the buyer's proof of funds (1 day)
Step 31. Review the termite inspection report (1 hour)
Step 32. Perform the final verification of the buyer's credit (1 day)
Step 33. Receive the "Clear to Close" from the lender (4 hours)
Step 34. Release the earnest money from the escrow account (1 hour)
Step 35. Review the plot map and survey (3 hours)
Step 36. Order a professional home inspection (3 days)
Step 37. Execute the occupancy agreement (30 minutes)
Step 38. Gather the seller's government-issued identification (15 minutes)
Step 39. Confirm the funding of the loan (2 hours)
Step 40. Secure the power of attorney if needed (1 day)
Step 41. Sign the mortgage/deed of trust (1 hour)
Step 42. Verify the property address with the postal service (30 minutes)
Step 43. Request the HOA resale certificate (1 week)
Step 44. Calculate the final cash-to-close amount (2 hours)
Step 45. Issue the final title insurance policy (1 day)
Step 46. Disburse the real estate agent commissions (1 hour)
Step 47. Verify the seller’s bank wiring instructions (30 minutes)
Step 48. Check the status of the certificate of occupancy (2 days)
Step 49. Order a location survey (4 days)
Step 50. Validate the buyer's identity (30 minutes)
Step 51. Review the flood zone certification (1 hour)
Step 52. Secure the lead-based paint disclosure (1 hour)
Step 53. Sign the tax authorization forms (15 minutes)
Step 54. Collect the keys and garage door openers (15 minutes)
Step 55. Cut checks for the property transfer taxes (1 hour)
Step 56. Provide the buyer with the title commitment (2 days)
Step 57. Sign the compliance agreement (15 minutes)
Step 58. Review the loan estimate (1 hour)
Step 59. Order the environmental hazards report (3 days)
Step 60. Request the mortgage credit report (2 days)
Step 61. Confirm the payoff of the second mortgage (1 day)
Step 62. Execute the signature affidavit (15 minutes)
Step 63. Open the escrow account (2 hours)
Step 64. Review the homeowner association bylaws (3 hours)
Step 65. Provide the foreign investment in real property tax act (FIRPTA) affidavit (2 hours)
Step 66. Sign the error and omissions agreement (15 minutes)
Step 67. Notify the property manager of the transfer (30 minutes)
Step 68. Review the municipal lien search results (1 day)
Step 69. Confirm the property is vacant (2 hours)
Step 70. Schedule the final carpet cleaning (1 day)
Step 71. Sign the initial escrow instructions (30 minutes)
Step 72. Verify the home warranty coverage (1 hour)
Step 73. Order the preliminary title commitment (2 days)
Step 74. Prepare the property tax withholding forms (1 hour)
Step 75. Order the land survey (5 days)
Step 76. Receive the buyer's loan application (1 day)
Step 77. File the mortgage satisfaction document (3 days)
Step 78. Verify the repair receipts from the inspection (2 hours)
Step 79. Sign the occupancy affidavit (15 minutes)
Step 80. Conduct the initial file intake (1 hour)
Step 81. Provide the Patriot Act disclosure (30 minutes)
Step 82. Verify the legal names on the title (1 hour)
Step 83. Confirm the loan interest rate lock (15 minutes)
Step 84. Review the appraisal for accuracy (2 hours)
Step 85. Check the property for any active building permits (1 day)
Step 86. Verify the smoke detector compliance (1 hour)
Step 87. Sign the W-9 for tax reporting (15 minutes)
Step 88. Retain a title company (1 day)
Step 89. Sign the equal credit opportunity act notice (10 minutes)
Step 90. Draft the warranty deed (1 hour)
Step 91. Review the septic system clearance (2 days)
Step 92. Sign the closing statement (30 minutes)
Step 93. Provide the initial privacy notice (10 minutes)
Step 94. Verify the seller's marital status for the deed (30 minutes)
Step 95. Confirm the transfer of the home security system (1 hour)
Step 96. Deliver the final closing package to the buyer (2 hours)
Step 97. Review the property's zoning classification (3 hours)
Step 98. Sign the acknowledgment of receipt of the CD (10 minutes)
Step 99. Verify the buyer's employment (1 day)
Step 100. Review the property's metes and bounds (2 hours)
